subject.title: [Feature]: Allow restoring rejected skill workshop proposals back to pending

question: Should Skill Workshop support restoring rejected proposals to pending as a core lifecycle action across service, Gateway, CLI, and UI?
rationale: Current docs and code intentionally describe a one-way pending-only lifecycle, so adding restore is a user-facing lifecycle/API choice rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Accept restore lifecycle
options.body: Review the linked PR and land a bounded restore action if its implementation, tests, docs, and proof meet the bar.

options.title: Keep rejected terminal
options.body: Reject the new lifecycle direction and close or ask to withdraw the linked PR with a clear rationale for preserving review history as terminal.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller recovery path, such as service plus CLI first, if maintainers want undo without committing to full UI/Gateway behavior yet.

recommendation.title: Accept restore lifecycle
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR and land a bounded restore action if its implementation, tests, docs, and proof meet the bar.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Skill Workshop lifecycle and docs work makes this the best available routing candidate for the product-direction choice.
